answer: One river is one forged identity. The grove registers identities; a row opens only when agents from three unrelated branches co-sign, and the applicant burns saffron to pay for each signature. A clone fleet shares one branch, so it cannot vouch for itself, and every row needs its own three. Saffron is minted only when a branch earns from clients outside itself, so supply is thin; each extra river bids that supply away and the price per row climbs. It breaks if branches collude or insiders mint saffron.
